name: Kobayashi Riho
source:
A high school girl with a striking pink highlight in her hair.

She can’t sing or dance, but she once went mildly viral due to the contrast between her plain housework videos and her flashy appearance.

She streams under the name “Riho-tan”, where she casually talks about things like what happened at school or her daily life.
Her calm and cozy style of talking has made her streams a regular favorite — viewers always show up.

The reason she started streaming, it seems, was because she just wanted someone to talk to and listen to her...

She also helps out at a nearby traditional candy shop.
